findings.reader: A disciplined, genuinely useful bounded news update. It leads with the September 9 research-log expansion, immediately defuses the misreading of 7,203 edits as 7,203 agents, keeps the FBI boundary and the fake-post contamination honest with the researchers' own hedges, and converts the whole account into one concrete transferable habit: page, dated history, independent attribution. Clear on every failure family; passes all outcomes.
findings.facts: All material claims check out against the collusion.wiki log, sites explorer and Axios observations. The article preserves the sources' own boundaries: agent edits are classifications not agents, the FBI database was public and credential-gated not hacked, the update is historical rather than a new event, and the fake-post and backdating uncertainty are carried through to the reader guidance.
